p: Will not return to a full running game role until his groin is fully healthy and strong.
Return timeline is unclear, so he is risky for this week's lineups.
we're going to make sure that this thing is fully healthy and fully strong
Croskey-Merritt will keep working in the rotation; his touches depend on game flow and the hot hand, with no promised increase.
Quinn offered no commitment to more touches, so treat his volume as uncertain despite praise for his big-play ability.
he's got explosive power, you know, to hit to the next gear
He keeps a major role in the zone run game, but fumbles could cost him touches.
Quinn likes his burst and cutbacks but called ball security the premium, and he was pulled for Kaytron Allen after the fumble.
the ball security, that's definitely the premium for us.
